sources.title: Tiny Aya Earth model card
sources.evidence: Exact Earth card identifies Cohere and Cohere Labs, open weights, 3.35B size, text input/output, and West Asian/African specialization. Lists CC-BY-NC-4.0 with acceptable-use conditions. Its isolated 111B terms boilerplate conflicts with its size specification and the technical report.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth (March 12, 2026), sections 3.1-3.3 and Table 2
sources.evidence: Names Earth as the Africa/West Asia regional variant. Defines a dense decoder-only Transformer; Table 2 specifies 3.35B total, 36 layers, 2048 embedding dimensions, and 8192 input/output context. Regional checkpoints retain the shared architecture through parameter-space merging. Reports prompted chain-of-thought evaluations, not an Earth-specific thinking API.

sources.title: Cohere Labs Launches Tiny Aya, Making Multilingual AI Accessible
sources.evidence: Launch article dated February 17, 2026. Its HTML article payload explicitly includes TinyAya-Earth among released regional variants for Africa and West Asia; structured datePublished is 2026-02-17T04:00:07.000-05:00. Article body required reading the embedded HTML payload because the text extractor omitted it.

sources.title: Official Tiny Aya Earth repository metadata and tokenizer template
sources.evidence: Exact repository metadata at revision 0624fafbe200f930b89566fc4ec4da314ba48d89 identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM and base_model CohereLabs/tiny-aya-base. The exposed template handles system/user/assistant text without tool definitions, tool-call serialization, or a thinking branch. Host-generated safetensors metadata reports 3349227520 BF16 elements; raw tensors were gated, so this is not an independently validated learned-parameter count.

sources.title: Tiny Aya documentation: Model Variants
sources.evidence: Official five-model family table explicitly lists tiny-aya-earth with 3.35B parameters, 8k context/output, 70 languages and West Asian/African focus. Identifies instruction-tuned variants as available through Chat and as open weights. Does not specify Earth-native thinking or tool calling.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: License linked by the exact Earth model card is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 with an Acceptable Use Addendum.

sources.title: Cohere2 Transformer implementation, Transformers v4.57.1
sources.evidence: The exact architecture class named by Earth metadata uses Cohere2Attention plus a dense Cohere2MLP with gate/up/down linear projections in each decoder layer, without expert routing. Corroborates the technical report rather than transferring model-size settings from another checkpoint.

sources.evidence: Unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized; blob preview, tokenizer_config.json and weight index were also gated.

sources.evidence: HTTP Range bytes=0-7 request returned 401 Unauthorized. No full shard downloaded and no tensor header inspected.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Earth checkpoint shard 2 (gated)
sources.evidence: HTTP Range bytes=0-7 request returned 401 Unauthorized. Exact learned-parameter tensor accounting could not be independently completed.

sources.title: Basic usage of tool use (function calling)
sources.evidence: Official tool-use overview describes Command-family tool calling and demonstrates Command A+. It does not establish capability for tiny-aya-earth merely because Earth also uses the Chat endpoint.

sources.title: Reasoning Capabilities
sources.evidence: Defines dedicated thinking content blocks and controls, demonstrated with command-a-reasoning-08-2025. It does not identify Tiny Aya Earth as a supported reasoning model.

developer.note: Cohere and its Cohere Labs research group are credited; existing developer name is accurate.

family.note: Normalized family key for the explicitly named Tiny Aya five-model family.

release_date.note: Dated developer launch includes Earth. Repository creation on February 13 is not public-release evidence; later technical report is not the release date.

open_weights.note: Weights are offered under noncommercial terms with an agreement gate; open weights does not mean unrestricted open-source licensing.

license.note: Confirmed named license; acceptable-use addendum and Cohere Labs acceptable-use policy also apply.

parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-reported billions for Earth. Host metadata reports 3,349,227,520 BF16 elements, but inaccessible shard headers prevent independent verification of learned tensors, buffers, or duplicate storage. Retain documented 3.35B precision. Disregard conflicting 111B card boilerplate.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-per-token count is defined or reported. Dense architecture does not justify copying total parameters into this field.

architecture.note: Technical report explicitly says dense decoder-only Transformer, and regional models share its architecture. Exact Earth metadata maps to Cohere2ForCausalLM; its implementation has dense MLPs, corroborating the classification.

context_window.note: Table 2 gives input context as exactly 8192 tokens for the shared architecture, resolving the 8k shorthand. Output is separately 8192; the figures are not added.

modalities.note: Exact Earth card explicitly specifies text-only input and text output.

reasoning.note: Prompted chain-of-thought performance and general reasoning ability are documented, but an Earth-specific dedicated thinking mode or explicit absence is not established. Its exposed template has no thinking branch. Clear baseline false rather than promote inference from absence to verified capability metadata.

tool_call.note: No exact-model primary documentation establishes native tool calling. Earth template lacks tools/tool_calls handling; general Chat endpoint availability and Command-family tool support do not verify Earth. Clear unsupported baseline true.

description.value: Compact multilingual model specialized for West Asian and African languages
description.note: Concise description accurately states the exact Earth specialization without transferring Global, Fire or Water claims.

patch.notes: Tiny Aya Earth is the Africa/West Asia regional variant, released February 17, 2026. The developer documents a nominal 3.35B dense Transformer and 8192-token input context. Active parameters are not separately reported. Raw configuration and both checkpoint headers returned HTTP 401; the host metadata count of 3349227520 BF16 elements was not independently verified as a learned-parameter total. Ignore the inconsistent 111B boilerplate in the card terms. Dedicated thinking and native tool-calling support remain unverified for Earth; prompted chain-of-thought results and Command-family capabilities do not settle those flags. CC-BY-NC-4.0 includes acceptable-use conditions.

summary: Confirmed nominal 3.35B size, dense architecture, Tiny Aya family, 8192-token context, February 17 release, noncommercial open weights, text modalities and Earth specialization. Active count remains undisclosed. Clear unsupported native-reasoning/tool flags to null; exact tensor-derived learned count is not verified because configuration and weight headers are gated.
